svg.title: How a felix/v1 manifest becomes a governed Agent
svg.desc: Every request compiles its agent from scratch. resolve_tenant_manifest picks a manifest version, prepare_tenant_invoke enforces the manifest's own inbound auth rule and pins the version to the thread, then build_agent resolves base tools from the ToolProvider, binds outbound tools named in the spec — MCP servers, A2A peers, browsers, sandboxes, queues — appends the Agent Skills catalog to the prompt and a recalled-facts prelude beside it, wraps every resolved tool in the governance stack, and hands the result to a pattern builder from the open registry. Nothing in core enumerates patterns; build_react_agent is simply the one most manifests name.
